degree: M.S. in Marriage and Family Therapy
format: Primarily in-person, some hybrid courses

Students may only work at sites that have a contract in good standing with the university. You can find a list of currently approved sites on your cohort's dedicated Canvas page.

min_gpa: 2.85 for domestic applicants or 3.00 for international applicants

degree: M.S. in Marital and Family Therapy
notable: Curriculum aligned with COAMFTE standards (not accredited); 300 client-contact-hour practicum
placement_evidence: The MFT program provides its students with a directory of sites with approved sites accessible in Tevera to eligible students after completing the Fieldwork Orientation(s) ... Students should select three (3) agencies of interest at a minimum and engage in the interview process before choosing one agency.

degree: M.S. in Psychology (marketed as MFT)

MFT students are not placed or “matched” with a site, but instead are able to choose the site that best fits their interests. Every Spring semester we host a “Traineeship Forum” where students can meet with our community partners.
practicum_hours: Students must obtain a minimum of 225 face-to-face clinical hours in order to graduate.
practicum_length: On-campus practica in the CTC across years one and two, then the community traineeship for the whole of year three at about 20 hours a week
gre_evidence: Standardized test scores (i.e. GRE, MAT, etc.) are NOT required for admission to the MFT program.

degree: M.S. in Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy Concentration (Counseling Track; also a Behavior Analysis Track)

gre_evidence: Note: The Graduate Record Examination is no longer required.
min_gpa: A minimum 3.0 overall grade point average.

notice.title: The Board has issued a Notice to Students about this school
notice.body: Sentio holds provisional approval from the Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education, and that approval expires in July 2028. Per the Board’s notice, a Sentio graduate may register as an Associate and may sit the California Law and Ethics exam — but may not sit the Clinical Exam, and therefore cannot be licensed, until Sentio is fully accredited. If accreditation is not achieved by July 2028, Associates registered on this degree are disqualified and their supervised hours will not be accepted. That is the whole pathway, so read the notice itself before applying — and note that the school appears on the Board’s qualifying-degree list at the same time.

The entrance exam is used for tracking progress of learning by comparing the entrance exam score with the exit exam score received upon graduation. The entrance exam is a requirement for admission before being fully accepted into the program, and yet is not used as a factor of acceptance or denial.

note: The programme page states it meets Board requirements for both LMFT and LPCC. With Cal Poly Humboldt it is one of only two options on the Board’s list sited in far northern California, which is most of the reason to know about it.
format: In class two nights a week, in 7-week terms
degree: M.A. in Counseling Psychology (MACP)
placement_evidence: During the final year of study, students also experience excellent clinical training at a variety of trusted practicum sites within the broader community, where they work under the supervision of a licensed professional.
practicum_length: Final year of study
gre_evidence: No GRE required
min_gpa: 3.0 cumulative GPA (for final 60 semester credits – applicants with a lower GPA may still be considered through our holistic admissions process)

note: The Board lists it for LMFT and LPCC. The programme page describes the Board-required training components but does not itself name the LPCC pathway.

degree: M.A. in Marriage and Family Therapy (MAMFT)
placement_evidence: CO-771 Counseling Practicum 1, CO-772 Counseling Practicum 2, CO-773 Counseling Practicum 3 [...] CO-778 Practicum Continuance (optional)

gre_evidence: Schedule MMPI (MACP, MAMFT, PsyD), Entrance Exam (PsyD only)

note: California residents only, by design — the programme exists to satisfy the California Board. Read it as an out-of-state institution delivering a California-specific degree, not as a California campus.
format: Fully online and asynchronous, in 5–6 week courses
city: Online (Phoenix, AZ; enrolment restricted to California residents)
degree: M.S. in Counseling, Marriage, Family and Child Therapy
placement_evidence: Students are required to secure their own clinical placement site.
practicum_hours: A minimum of 300 direct client hours are required to graduate.

note: One of the few schools on the Board’s list that says it in its own words: the programme page states it is “approved by the state of California’s Board of Behavioral Sciences (BBS) for both LPCC and LMFT licensure requirements.”
format: Online only
degree: M.A. in Counseling Psychology and Wellness
placement_evidence: Students will complete 6 units (600 hours) of practicum thus completing 280 hours of direct client contact in a supervised clinical placement counseling individuals, couples, families, or groups.
practicum_hours: 280 of those hours must be direct client contact in a clinical setting counseling individuals, couples, families, or groups

note: Tuition is $9,600 a year, charged as an annual subscription rather than per unit — on any ordinary completion timeline that makes it by a wide margin the cheapest LMFT-qualifying degree on the Board’s list. Two things to weigh against that. It is accredited by DEAC, a national rather than a regional accreditor, which is the distinction that decides whether a degree travels. And the unit count is not on the website; it is in the June 2026 catalog PDF. Non-profit, founded 1975.
format: Online
degree: M.S. in Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy

note: Board-approved since 1992, and the page states it satisfies both the AMFT/LMFT and APCC/LPCC registration paths. The seminary is Oregon-based; the California counseling degree is delivered from the San Jose campus, which is what the Board lists.
